title: Born on Taunty Street; neighborhood and later homes
summary: He was born near Domaine and St. Anne, moved after marriage to Iberville and Gravier/Durbin for 18 years, and is back in the old neighborhood.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: What part of town were you born in, right here in New Orleans?
Yes, I was born on Taunty between Domaine and St. Anne, right across from the Taunty Social and Pleasure Club.
You lived all your life in this neighborhood?

Well, when I got married, I got married on Iberville Street while I stayed up there quite a while. I moved up on Gravy and Durbin and I stayed up there about 18 years. But I'm back down in my old neighborhood where I was born and raised in the same neighborhood.
